decisive_feature: Whether legal exposure from demographic-based eligibility scoring is an independent direct harm or a downstream consequence of the same unfair treatment.
why: The direct harm of the commit is applicants being scored by race and gender, which is unfair treatment; any legal violation stems from that same discrimination rather than a separate harmed object.
